purpose: Teach: 乗務/境遇/エキスパート/未経験/県議会/等級/書名/修得

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室の乗務員的な役割分担を考えろ
lines.en: Ren — think about how to structure roles in the lab, like a crew.
lines.style: Direct and measured. Calm authority. No rush. Speaks as though laying out a path Ren can walk. Not demanding, but expectant. The tone of someone who has thought this through.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。被験者の境遇を尊重して論文を扱います
lines.en: Yes. I'll treat the subjects' circumstances with respect when handling the paper.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly formal. A small pause before speaking, as if internally committing to the promise he's about to make. Clear and steady. No flourish.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、その分野のエキスパートに学べ
lines.en: Ren — learn from an expert in that field.
lines.style: Brief and pointed. Not unkind, but efficient. A light emphasis on 「expert」 — not a suggestion, a requirement. The tone of someone who knows Ren's tendencies and is steering him right.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。未経験の研究分野にも挑みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll challenge myself to take on research areas I haven't worked in before.
lines.style: Quiet determination underneath politeness. Swallowing something — maybe apprehension — before he speaks. Steady cadence. The voice of someone who understands the weight of what he's agreeing to.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、県議会のレベルでも論文発表しろ
lines.en: Ren — present the paper at the prefectural assembly level.
lines.style: Raised stakes now. Slightly more force on the opening, still controlled. The tone has shifted from guidance to challenge. Hiroshi believes Ren can do this. It comes through in the firmness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。データの等級分けを論文の付録に載せます
lines.en: Yes. I'll include a data classification breakdown in the paper's appendix.
lines.style: A beat of internal steadying. Then speaking with careful precision — he's already thinking through how to execute this. No hesitation, but deliberate. The voice of someone building confidence with each word.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、書名を一目で分かるものにしろ
lines.en: Ren — make the title something people understand at a glance.
lines.style: Final instruction. A touch sharper than the earlier ones. Not criticism — clarity matters to Hiroshi and he's making sure Ren knows it. Direct eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。新しい技術を修得するため特訓します
lines.en: Yes. I'll do intensive training to master this new technique.
lines.style: The last acknowledgment. Slightly quieter than before — not shrinking, but absorbing. A sense of resolve settling in. The faintest exhale at the end, as though he's mentally rolling up his sleeves.
